title: synth.piano~
description: `synth.piano~` is a waveguide commuted piano synthesizer that produces separate left and right audio outputs. Play it with `note NOTE VEL` or a `NOTE VEL` list, where NOTE is a MIDI note and velocity ranges from 0 to 127; its piano model can be adjusted with properties such as brightness, detuning, hammer hardness, stiffness, pan, and reverb.
